prompt: This blood pressure drug commonly used to treat gestational hypertension was patented the same year the first black student at the University of Mississippi was shot.
answer: The drug is **labetalol**, a beta- and alpha-adrenergic blocker commonly used to treat hypertension during pregnancy. It was patented in **1966**, the year James Meredith was shot during the March Against Fear.
